title: DBM seeks 7-fold boost in 2027 EV program budget to P229 million

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Budget and Management (DBM) is asking Congress for an almost P229-million budget for the Electric Vehicle Industry Development Program (EVIDP) for 2027 as the country further reduces its dependence on imported fossil fuel and transitions to cleaner transportation. The DBM’s request for a P228.92 million proposed funding for EVIDP next year is more than seven times — equivalent to an increase of 605.17 percent — its P32.46 million allocation under the 2026 national budget. The increase will support the Electric Vehicle Infrastructure Scoping, Implementation and Operationalization in Selected Government Offices (EVision) Project, as well as […]...
